Common questions.

What does a free account include?

A verified account gives you an identity for account settings and supported customer services. Paid workspace access depends on the permissions on your account. An eligible owner can open either workspace directly.

When can I purchase a plan?

The plans page checks billing readiness. Prices are in USD and yearly charges are paid in advance. Checkout opens only when the payment integration is ready.

Which market tools are available?

The terminal shows the selected provider, coverage and timestamps. News, calendar, AI, brokerage and execution each depend on their own connection and permissions.

What happens after a project request?

An operator can review your brief, clarify requirements and discuss a proposal. The request alone creates no order or delivery commitment.

How do I follow a support conversation?

Open Support in the same browser to read sent messages and replies in your conversation history.

Does signing in authorize trading?

Live execution requires separate broker authorization, trading permissions and enabled release controls. Exploring the sample or requesting a system places no orders.
